entries.description: Clone a clump template. The new clump template has name s and no clumps refer to the created clump template.

entries.name: clump.template.delete
entries.description: Delete a clump template. All clumps that referred to this clump template no longer refer to any clump template.

entries.name: clump.template.deletepebble
entries.description: Delete a pebble from a clump. This operation has no impact on the clump template inertial attributes. The clump no longer refers to a clump template.

entries.name: clump.template.euler
entries.description: Get the clump template relative orientation.

entries.name: clump.template.euler.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the clump template relative orientation.

entries.description: Get/set the y-component of the clump template relative orientation.

entries.name: clump.template.euler.z
entries.description: Get/set the z-component of the clump template relative orientation.

entries.description: Find a clump template pebble.

entries.name: clump.template.make

entries.description: Get the maximum clump template ID.

entries.name: clump.template.scale
entries.description: Get clump template relative scaling factor. This is that factor by which the clump template must be scaled to match the clump size.

entries.name: clump.template.typeid
entries.description: Get the clump template type number. The typeid can be used to uniquely identify clump template FISH pointers from any other type of FISH pointer.

entries.name: clump.template.vol
entries.description: Get/set the clump template volume. In 2D, this is the volume per unit thickness.

entries.name: clump.thermal.clump
entries.description: Get the pointer to the host mechanical clump.

entries.name: clump.thermal.contact.list
entries.description: Get active thermal contacts around a thermal clump. The optional arguments enable filtering by contacting piece type and/or contacting piece pointer.

entries.name: clump.thermal.contact.list.all
entries.description: Get all thermal contacts around a thermal clump. (Inactive thermal contacts are included.) The optional arguments enable filtering by contacting piece type and/or contacting piece pointer.

entries.name: clump.thermal.contactmap
entries.description: Get active thermal contacts around a thermal clump. The optional arguments enable filtering by contacting piece type and/or contacting piece pointer.

entries.name: clump.thermal.contactmap.all
entries.description: Get all thermal contacts around a thermal clump. (Inactive thermal contacts are included.) The optional arguments enable filtering by contacting piece type and/or contacting piece pointer.

entries.name: clump.thermal.contactnum
entries.description: Get the number of active thermal contacts around a thermal clump. The optional argument enables filtering by contacting piece type.

entries.name: clump.thermal.contactnum.all
entries.description: Get the number of thermal contacts around a thermal clump. (Inactive contacts are included.) The optional argument enables filtering by contacting piece type.

entries.name: clump.thermal.expansion
entries.description: Get/set the thermal-expansion coefficient.

entries.description: Get/set the thermal clump extra variable.

entries.description: Find a thermal clump.

entries.description: Get/set the temperature fixity condition.

entries.name: clump.thermal.group
entries.description: Get/set thermal clump groups. Note that groups are shared with the mechanical hosts, where the associated data is stored.

entries.name: clump.thermal.group.list
entries.description: Get a list of thermal clumps that belong to the group named s. The arguments s and slot may be specified as strings or indices. If slot is not specified, then all slots are queried.

entries.name: clump.thermal.group.remove
entries.description: Remove thermal clump groups. The specified group name is removed from all group slots. Note that groups are shared with the mechanical hosts, where the associated data is stored.

entries.name: clump.thermal.groupmap
entries.description: Get thermal clumps that belong to a group.

entries.name: clump.thermal.id
entries.description: Get the thermal clump ID.

entries.name: clump.thermal.inbox
entries.description: Get thermal clumps with extents intersecting a box. The extent is the axis-aligned bounding box of the clump. Specifying b = false indicates that only clumps with positions falling in the box are returned.

entries.name: clump.thermal.isgroup
entries.description: Query the existence of a group. If slot is not provided then all slots are queried. Note that groups are shared with the mechanical hosts, where the associated data is stored.

entries.name: clump.thermal.list
entries.description: Get the global thermal clump list. Use the loop foreach construct to iterate through the list.

entries.name: clump.thermal.near
entries.description: Find the closest thermal clump to a point. If frad is specified, then the search radius is limited.

entries.name: clump.thermal.num
entries.description: Get the number of thermal clumps.

entries.name: clump.thermal.pebble.clump
entries.description: Get the thermal pebble’s thermal clump.

entries.name: clump.thermal.pebble.contact.list
entries.description: Get active thermal contacts around a thermal pebble.

entries.name: clump.thermal.pebble.contact.list.all
entries.description: Get all thermal contacts around a thermal pebble (Inactive thermal contacts are included).

entries.name: clump.thermal.pebble.contactmap
entries.description: Get active thermal contacts around a thermal pebble.

entries.name: clump.thermal.pebble.contactmap.all
entries.description: Get all thermal contacts around a thermal pebble (Inactive thermal contacts are included).

entries.name: clump.thermal.pebble.contactnum
entries.description: Get the number of active thermal contacts around a thermal pebble. The optional argument enables filtering by contacting piece type.

entries.name: clump.thermal.pebble.contactnum.all
entries.description: Get the number of thermal contacts around a thermal pebble. (Inactive thermal contacts are included.) The optional argument enables filtering by contacting piece type.

entries.name: clump.thermal.pebble.find
entries.description: Find a thermal pebble.

entries.name: clump.thermal.pebble.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to thermal pebble pt in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: clump.thermal.pebble.group.list
entries.description: Get a list of thermal pebbles that belong to the group named s. The arguments s and slot may be specified as strings or indices*. If slot is not specified, then all slots are queried.

entries.name: clump.thermal.pebble.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the thermal pebble in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: clump.thermal.pebble.groupmap
entries.description: Get thermal pebbles that belong to a group.

entries.name: clump.thermal.pebble.id
entries.description: Get/set the thermal pebble ID.

entries.name: clump.thermal.pebble.inbox
entries.description: Get thermal pebbles with extents intersecting a box. The extent is the axis-aligned bounding box of the pebble. Specifying b = false indicates that only pebbles with positions falling in the box are returned.

entries.name: clump.thermal.pebble.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the thermal pebble and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: clump.thermal.pebble.isprop
entries.description: Query the existence of a property.

entries.name: clump.thermal.pebble.list
entries.description: Get the global thermal pebble list. Use the loop foreach construct to iterate through the list.

entries.name: clump.thermal.pebble.near
entries.description: Find the closest thermal pebble to a point. If frad is specified, then the search radius is limited.

entries.name: clump.thermal.pebble.num
entries.description: Get the number of thermal pebbles.

entries.name: clump.thermal.pebble.pebble
entries.description: Get the host mechanical pebble.

entries.name: clump.thermal.pebble.pos
entries.description: Get the position of the thermal pebble, or one of its components.

entries.name: clump.thermal.pebble.pos.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the position of the thermal pebble.

entries.name: clump.thermal.pebble.pos.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of the position of the thermal pebble.

entries.name: clump.thermal.pebble.pos.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of the position of the thermal pebble.

entries.name: clump.thermal.pebble.prop
entries.description: Get/set a thermal pebble property. The function clump.thermal.pebble.isprop can be used to assess the existence of a property.

entries.name: clump.thermal.pebble.typeid
entries.description: Get the thermal pebble type number. The type ID can be used to uniquely identify thermal pebble FISH pointers and distinguish them from any other type of FISH pointer.

entries.name: clump.thermal.pebblelist
entries.description: Get the thermal pebbles of a thermal clump. Use the loop foreach construct to iterate through the list.

entries.name: clump.thermal.power.app
entries.description: Get/set the thermal applied power.

entries.name: clump.thermal.power.unbal
entries.description: Get the unbalanced thermal power.

entries.name: clump.thermal.prop
entries.description: Set a property of all thermal pebbles.

entries.name: clump.thermal.specific.heat
entries.description: Get/set the specific heat coefficient.

entries.name: clump.thermal.temp
entries.description: Get/set the temperature.

entries.name: clump.thermal.temp.increment
entries.description: Get/set the current temperature increment.

entries.name: clump.thermal.typeid
entries.description: Get the thermal clump type number. The type ID can be used to uniquely identify clump FISH pointers and distinguish them from any other type of FISH pointer.
